Flow.description:
F-05: Finance Approval Screen Flow. Sequential D&B validation → KYC review (with due diligence checks, document upload, warnings) → Credit Decision. Invoked from the Finance Approval quick action on the Account record page. No skip option for D&B. KYC rejection routes to Legal_Review_Pending for legal resolution via separate action.
SFDEV-46: Removed Sales Team field from Get Account element
Flow.label: Account - Screen - Finance Approval
